key_design_decisions.rationale: Zero main context burden; no agent spawning required; hooks run detached subprocess
key_design_decisions.tradeoff: Slightly higher filesystem I/O (mitigated by batching)

key_design_decisions.rationale: Prevent I/O thrashing; batch writes; handle spike in artifact generation
key_design_decisions.tradeoff: Buffer must be thread-safe; requires flusher daemon

key_design_decisions.rationale: Space efficiency; permanent audit trail; comply with immutability constraint
Main never blocks; if capture slow, queue it instead of blocking
key_design_decisions.tradeoff: Hook timeout_ms must be tuned per artifact type (2-3 seconds)

pre-submit.description: Capture user prompt before API submission

post-submit.description: Capture Claude API response after submission

post-tool-call.description: Capture tool invocation results (Bash, Read, Edit, etc)

artifact_types.responses: JSON object, full Claude API response + tokens
artifact_types.errors: JSON object, exception snapshot with context
artifact_types.prompts: TXT (plain text), user message + system context

guarantees.zero_main_blocking: All hooks return <100ms; I/O in subprocess (detached)
guarantees.complete_lineage: task_id, session_id, timestamp in every filename
guarantees.forensic_integrity: SHA256 hash in COC entry; court-ready recovery
